title: Review of Petrochemical Companies' Governance Processes after Recent Case of Theft of Fuel from Pulau Bukom
what_it_is: Review of Petrochemical Companies' Governance Processes after Recent Case of Theft of Fuel from Pulau Bukom

sections.label: Petroleum storage licensing and security
sections.summary: Petrochemical companies storing large amounts of petroleum and flammable materials must obtain an annually renewed SCDF licence and put in place security measures.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Generally, petrochemical companies which store large amounts of petroleum and flammable materials must obtain a licence from the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF).

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The licence is renewed annually and applicants must put in place security measures to prevent unauthorised access to, and unauthorised activities involving the petroleum and flammable materials.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Licences that involve volatile petroleum and flammable materials are deemed to be of higher risk and are subjected to site inspections to assess the adequacy of their physical security measures.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Licensees are also required to immediately notify the SCDF of any loss or theft of petroleum and flammable materials from their premises and put in place measures to prevent recurrence.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Home Affairs (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Beyond physical security measures, companies storing petroleum and flammable materials have a duty to establish robust internal governance and oversight to safeguard their petroleum and flammable materials.

sections.label: Shell Bukom inspection and investigations
sections.summary: Shell Bukom was last inspected in December 2017 and met licensing conditions, and investigations into the thefts are before the Courts.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In the case of Shell Bukom, they were, in fact, last inspected in December 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: At that time, they were found to have met with the compliance requirements of the licensing conditions.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The matter is before the Courts, so I cannot say very much more, except that the investigations seek to reveal how the thefts occurred, and this may or may not have anything to do with the adequacy of the security measures.
